title: the-decompose-door-accepts-a-commons-output
intention: The decompose door's writes_to check accepts an address inside CairnCommons as well as inside the cairn repo, so a concept-piece's chart (its only output a .md in the commons) can berth.
why: No concept-piece can be charted today: write_decompose refuses a writes_to outside the cairn repo, and a concept-piece's only output is a .md in CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code, so its BUILDME entry lane a_berthed_chart_chain_claims_the_ticket never opens. Measured 2026-10-04: df05d93da4c0's chart refused at decompose ('is outside the cairn repo'). The rule's why (68f1fc073512: a write this system does not gate and git cannot see) is false for the commons, and Akien answered open-90d38cb2bdca 'a agreed'.
traces_to: Akien's answer to CairnCommons/questions/open-90d38cb2bdca.json ('a agreed'); Law 6; Law 9; RULE 1 (inside codemother's decompose machine; the promotion judge it composes is sibling fb85042b8342)
how: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/decompose.py writes_to_lacks: an entry is in bounds when its normalized path lies under root or under os.path.join(os.path.dirname(root), 'CairnCommons'). Anything else still lacks, with a sentence naming both roots. A new proof beside the machine.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) writes_to_lacks over a piece whose writes_to is an absolute path under the commons root returns []; (2) /etc/passwd and a path under ~/.cairn each return one lack containing 'outside'; (3) that lack names both the cairn repo and CairnCommons. RED if any fails or test_chart_decompose reds. Horizon: this ticket PROVED and df05d93da4c0's chart berthed.
watchme: none, because df05d93da4c0's chart berthing (CairnCommons/tickets/df05d93da4c0-an-unvouched-green-completes-and-notifies.json) is the first use and is measured at its BUILDME
children: none, because the change is one function and one proof inside the decompose machine

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/decompose.py writes_to_lacks, before the loop add `commons = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(root), "CairnCommons")`; the in-bounds test becomes `any(resolved == r or resolved.startswith(r + os.sep) for r in (root, commons))` with `resolved = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, addr))` unchanged. The lack text becomes "%s: `writes_to` %s is outside the cairn repo and CairnCommons — a piece may only declare output this system gates writes to" (still containing 'outside the cairn repo', so test_chart_decompose.py:279 and :285 stay true). The docstring's 'IN-REPO' sentence names both roots and cites this ticket and Akien's answer to open-90d38cb2bdca.

D2: SETTLED: new proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/proofs/test_the_decompose_door_accepts_a_commons_output.py, the same shape as cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_green_over_a_red_under_other_conditions_notifies.py (docstring, _REPO_ROOT = parents[5], sys.path insert, PROVES dict, main() printing GREEN/RED, exit 1 on any fail). Each tooth imports `from cairn.devices.codemother.machines.decompose.decompose import writes_to_lacks` and `from cairn.tools.chain.grammar import CAIRN_ROOT` inside its body. Teeth: '1' test_a_commons_address_lacks_nothing: `writes_to_lacks([{"what": "p", "writes_to": [os.path.join(os.path.dirname(CAIRN_ROOT), "CairnCommons", "intentions-not-beside-code", "I-x.md")]}]) == []`. '2' test_an_address_outside_both_roots_still_lacks: for each of "/etc/passwd" and str(Path.home() / ".cairn" / "x.json"), the call returns exactly one lack containing 'outside'. '3' test_the_lack_names_both_roots: the /etc/passwd lack contains 'cairn repo' and 'CairnCommons'. Validation berths beside it through the tester seal.
